statement: There are integers K0, M0 > 0 and constants c, C > 0 with the following properties. Write wk = M02k, and let ZN (t, w) be the partition function on a torus of time length t and spatial circumference w. (i) In the cutoff plane, all joint moments of the variables (2.2) converge to those of the Euclidean field ϕ. The limiting Schwinger distributions are tempered, Euclidean invariant, and O(3) covariant. Their Osterwalder–Schrader reconstruction is the Wightman field of Theorem 1.1, with unique vacuum Ω and Hphys|Ω⊥ ≥ m > 0. For some real test f supported strictly in positive time, the one-field reflection norm E[ϕ1(θf)ϕ1(f)] is strictly positive. (ii) For all N ≥ K0 and k ≥ 0, 0 ≤ ∆N (wk) := 4 log ZN (wk, wk) − log ZN (2wk, 2wk) ≤ Ce−cwk . (2.3) 4 (iii) On these square tori and on the cutoff plane, the component moment measures Si r,N = (BN a2 )r X x1,...,xr E   r Y j=1 q ij xj   δ(x1,...,xr) are nonnegative. For arbitrary translated unit boxes Q1, . . . , Qr, Si r,N (Q1 × · · · × Qr) ≤ Cr r!, (2.4) uniformly in N ≥ K0, the square torus, the box positions, and the component indices.
